description: Prevision y Situacion de escalas en Puerto is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Autoridad Portuaria de Santander. It allows to see in plan the planned stopovers, as well as the ships in Port. Coverage: Autoridad Portuaria de Santander. The portal shows the English title as "Forecast and Situation of stopovers in Port" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Autoridad Portuaria de Santander. Its keywords include Puerto, Prevision, Buques, Fomento. The listing shows 1 download or service links in HTML. The listing shows 2025-12-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://datos.gob.es/avisolegal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
